name: Amor Fati Stoic Wisdom
shortDescription: A personal development application based on Stoic philosophy.
description: A personal development application based on Stoic philosophy. It utilizes an interactive roulette mechanism to deliver daily quotes and wisdom from authors like Marcus Aurelius, and builds the habit with daily streaks and rank progression. It includes a private journal and a night exam. It is free to use, with an optional Premium subscription. Your data stays on your phone unless you have Premium and sign in with Google to back it up to the cloud. The app has no ads.
